description: This file defines a JSF managed bean controller class 'TodoListController' for managing a to-do list application, including operations for adding, updating, and selecting to-do items, as well as handling PrimeFaces UI events.

classes.name: TodoListController
classes.description: A JSF managed bean controller for handling the to-do list UI, managing todo items, and handling PrimeFaces AJAX events.

methods.name: getTodoItems
methods.description: Returns the list of all to-do items.

methods.name: buttonUpdateAction
methods.description: Marks the selected to-do items as complete, with null safety handling and user feedback.

methods.name: buttonAddAction
methods.description: Creates a new TodoItem using current input fields and adds it to the list.

methods.name: setSelectedItems
methods.description: Sets the list of selected TodoItems.

methods.name: getSelectedItems
methods.description: Returns the list of selected TodoItems.

methods.name: onRowSelect
methods.description: Handles PrimeFaces row select event, displaying a message with the selected item's ID.

methods.name: onRowUnselect
methods.description: Handles PrimeFaces row unselect event, displaying a message with the unselected item's ID.
